common:generalComment.#text: Calcined coke is a high purity carbon material produced by heating green petroleum coke to drive off moisture, volatile matter, and impurities and to increase its electrical conductivity. It is used primarily in the production of anodes for aluminium smelting, as well as in graphite electrodes for electric arc furnaces and in carbon raisers in steel and foundry industries. The production route typically involves delayed coking, and the product is available to consumers and at plant level.

common:generalComment.#text: Elementary flow for particulate matter emitted to air, unspecified subcompartment, where the particle-size fraction is not specified. The reference property is mass, expressed in kilograms. No particular particle-size distribution, chemical composition, stack height or LCIA characterization factor is assigned by this Flow definition. Source context retained from the preceding version: Song et al. (2021), DOI 10.13671/j.hjkxxb.2021.0276, reports 0.01689 kg/t of particulate-matter emissions from clinker preheating and calcination after dust collection, without reporting particle size. This is a source-specific application example, not the amount per kilogram of this Flow or a requirement that all uses represent the same treatment technology. Actual emissions, controls and source evidence belong to the corresponding Process exchange; characterization coverage is assessed for the exact Flow and the selected LCIA method.

common:synonyms.#text: refractory brick; fire brick; heat-resistant brick; high-temperature brick; kiln brick; furnace brick
耐火砖；防火砖；耐热砖；高温砖；窑砖；炉砖

common:generalComment.#text: Refractory bricks are materials capable of maintaining structural and performance stability under high-temperature conditions. They are commonly used as linings in high-temperature industrial equipment such as kilns, furnaces, and boilers. Made primarily from high-alumina, silica, or magnesia-based materials, refractory bricks are manufactured through high-temperature firing. They are characterized by high heat resistance, thermal shock resistance, and strong chemical stability, making them widely used in industries such as metallurgy, construction materials, and chemicals.
耐火砖是一种能够在高温环境下保持结构和性能稳定的材料，通常用于高温工业设备如窑炉、熔炉和锅炉内衬。其主要原材料包括高铝矿物、硅质材料和镁质材料，通过高温烧制而成。耐火砖具有高耐热性、抗热震性以及较强的化学稳定性，在冶金、建材、化工等行业中广泛应用。

common:generalComment.#text: Alumina, also known as the oxide of aluminum, occurs both in pure form as corundum and in hydrated forms (as in bauxite). It is widely used in a variety of industrial abrasive materials due to its superior hardness and strength. Alumina can also be used as a coating to protect against abrasion and in refractory products due to its high melting point. In most industrial applications, corundum has been replaced by synthetic materials such as alumina, an aluminum oxide made from bauxite.
氧化铝又称铝的氧化物，以刚玉和水合形式（如铝土矿）存在。由于其硬度和强度极高，氧化铝被广泛用于各种工业研磨材料。氧化铝还可用作涂层以防止磨损，并因其熔点高而用于耐火产品。在大多数工业应用中，刚玉已被氧化铝等合成材料所取代，氧化铝是从铝土矿中提取的一种氧化铝。

common:generalComment.#text: Compressed air is air kept under a pressure that is greater than atmospheric pressure. It is an important medium for transfer of energy in industrial processes, and is used for power tools such as air hammers, drills, wrenches, and others. It is also used to atomize paint, to operate air cylinders for automation. Compressed air acts as an energy source for a variety of tools and machinery, and it is often an important part of many production processes.
压缩空气是指压力大于大气压力的空气。它是工业生产过程中传递能量的重要介质，可用于气锤、电钻、扳手等电动工具。它还用于雾化油漆、操作自动化气缸。压缩空气是各种工具和机械的能源，通常是许多生产流程的重要组成部分。

rock wool; stone wool; mineral-wool insulation

common:generalComment.#text: Rock wool insulation provides thermal and sound insulation and can be used as a firestop between floors. It is made from natural, sustainable material and typically contains up to 75 percent recycled content. Rock wool is essentially basalt lava rock and chalk, heated to high temperatures and then spun into fine fibers. It is commonly used in hydroponics because it is pH neutral. Stone wool is a furnace product of molten rock at a temperature of about 1600 °C.
岩棉绝缘材料提供热量和声音的隔绝，并可以在楼层之间用作防火隔断。它由天然、可持续的材料制成，通常包含高达75%的再生内容。岩棉本质上是玄武岩熔岩和白垩，加热到高温然后纺成细纤维。它在水培中常用，因为它的pH值是中性的。石棉是熔岩在大约1600°C的温度下的炉产品。

common:synonyms.#text: mineral oil; white mineral oil; liquid paraffin; paraffinum liquidum
矿物油；白矿油；液体石蜡

common:generalComment.#text: Mineral oil is a colorless, transparent, oily liquid derived from crude petroleum oil. It is utilized for various purposes including treating dry skin, constipation, eczema, cradle cap, and facilitating bowel movements. Mineral oil is also a by-product from the refining of crude oil and the manufacturing of gasoline and petroleum products. It is odorless and used in cosmetics, science labs, industrial settings, and more. Despite its industrial origins, it has applications in the kitchen and is a refined petroleum oil used as a laxative.
矿物油是一种由原油衍生而来的无色透明油状液体。它用于各种目的，包括治疗皮肤干燥、便秘、湿疹、乳痂和促进排便。矿物油也是原油精炼以及汽油和石油产品制造的副产品。它无味，用于化妆品、科学实验室、工业环境等。尽管它起源于工业，但它在厨房中也有应用，是一种用作泻药的精炼石油。
